text:
maria: post-deploy quickcheck — synth/smoke sampled 50 requests against embed route in eu-west1, 2/50 returned 5xx (502). rolling rollout still in progress for release-2026-03-22 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy report: release-2026-03-22 started 2026-03-22T14:12Z. Targets: api-prod (canary -> 100%). Current progress: 62%. Canary checks: PASS. Postdeploy smoke: WARNING. Link: https://deploy/release-2026-03-22

sam: saw the logs, p95 jumped briefly but overall latency OK. the 502s look like tokenizer errors not network timeouts.

li: tailing runtime logs now. getting repeated: `tokenizer-service | ERROR: Unexpected EOF while decoding token stream` on host eu-west1-3. small batch of short prompts only. snippet:
```
[2026-03-22T14:18:03Z] tokenizer-service pid=2345 ERR Unexpected EOF
[2026-03-22T14:18:03Z] runtime    pid=9876 WARN kv-cache miss
[2026-03-22T14:18:03Z] proxy      pid=4512 INFO upstream 502
```

ashley: maybe the tokenizer-v2 warmup path didn't run on that host after the image flip. suggest two options: 1) pin eu-west1 to model-variant `embed-1.4` while we investigate, or 2) roll back the last change to tokenizer sidecar. My vote: pin variant regionally.

ben: can we do a hot-restart of tokenizer sidecar on affected hosts first? cheaper and faster if it's a warmup race. patch or pin depends on blast radius.

maria: ok holding global rollout at 62%. initiating targeted mitigation: pin model variant in eu-west1 to `embed-1.4` (previous stable) for all routes that touch tokenizer until we validate. Running command now.

maria: command:
```
redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu-west1 --route /v1/embed --model embed-1.4 --reason "postdeploy tokenizer EOFs on tokenizer-v2"
```

deploy-bot: Action taken: pinned model `embed-1.4` for route `/v1/embed` in eu-west1 by maria at 2026-03-22T14:20Z. Rollout hold remains at 62%.

ashley: triggering a targeted smoke resample (200 requests) against eu-west1 prefills. will post results in 5m.

health-bot: smoke job started: job-id=smoke-1818008080-1 region=eu-west1 samples=200 type=postdeploy-synth

li: while we wait, I restarted tokenizer sidecar on eu-west1-3 to clear warmup state (no config change). watching logs.

health-bot: smoke job complete: job-id=smoke-1818008080-1 results: 200/200 OK, 0/200 5xx, p95=120ms, notes="all embed requests served by pinned variant"

sam: looks clean. good to keep rollout held at 62% for another 10m of observation, then we can resume if no regression. keep tokenization team looped.

maria: agreed — holding for 10m and notifying tokenizer eng: @li @ashley please follow up with a postmortem root-cause. if warmup race, add a preflight check in the canary job. :white_check_mark:

ben: acked. if smoke stays green, resume to 80% then full after another 15m.

deploy-bot: Hold recorded: rollout paused by maria. Observability window set: 10m. Next auto-action: resume -> 80% after observability window if no alerts.
